ChangeGate.description: Whether a promotion is recorded directly or through a reviewable change.

oneOf.description: `nyl promote` opens a pull request instead (M11).

GitOpsResourceMetadata.description: Metadata shared by local GitOps compiler resources.

labels.description: Literal labels used for organization and target selection.

name.description: Project-local identity, validated by the resource kind; remains static during discovery.

PathAttestations.description: The attestations a path requires, per scope.

environment.description: The environment-wide attestations required; omitted, every one the source environment declares.

units.description: Per covered unit, the attestation names required of it; an empty list asks for its receipt only.

oneOf.description: The source produced the value: a current receipt.
Published, and every required attestation passes for that state.

PromotionEndpoint.description: One end of a path. Set exactly one of `environment` and `target`.

target.description: A DeploymentTarget outside every environment (M11). Validation rejects it with `NYL-PROMOTE-UNSUPPORTED` until then.

attestations.description: Replaces the attestations required per scope, for `attested`, or adds requirements, for `published`. A scope the path does not name keeps the level's default.

changeGate.description: `none` writes the record directly. `pullRequest` opens a reviewable change instead; it needs M11, and validation rejects it with `NYL-PROMOTE-UNSUPPORTED` until then.

coverage.description: Per unit that runs as several deployments, such as a KubernetesPublication, which of them count toward its running-scoped attestations for this path: keyed by the unit's name in the source environment. `nyl validate` and `nyl plan` check every unit, group, and deployment named here against what the unit's kind lists for it. Omitted, every deployment of every unit counts.

evidence.description: The level every covered unit and the source must reach: `published` (the source produced the value, as a receipt) or `attested` (published, and every attestation the covered units and the source environment declare passes for that state). Default `published`.

from.description: The source: a declared Environment, never a template instance.

maxAttestationAge.description: Attestations older than this, such as `1h`, do not count. Omitted, attestations never age.

to.description: The target environment, whose desired state holds the records.

values.description: The promoted values by name; the names are what `$promotion` bindings read.

verifyArtifacts.description: Check that every promoted artifact still exists before recording. Default `true`.

PromotionSelect.description:
Which field of the source a promoted value reads: the same selectors, with
the same JSON Pointer semantics and resolver, as `$unit` references and
`nyl get`.

Set exactly one of the four forms:
`{unit, input}` reads the source unit's resolved spec;
`{unit, output, pointer?}` a declared, non-sensitive output of its receipt;
`{unit, artifact, kind?, pointer}` a field of an artifact its receipt lists,
relative to the artifact's `spec`; and `{input}` (a target source, M11)
a Release input of the target.

artifact.description: An artifact the unit's receipt lists.

input.description: JSON Pointer into the source unit's resolved spec, such as `/source` or `/releases/platform~1web/image`.

kind.description: The artifact kind the artifact must have.

output.description: A declared, non-sensitive output of the unit's receipt.

pointer.description: JSON Pointer inside the output, or inside the artifact's `spec`.

PromotionValue.description: A promoted value: which source field it reads.

select.description: The one source field the value reads: `{unit, input: <pointer>}`, `{unit, output, pointer?}`, or `{unit, artifact, kind?, pointer}`.

UnitCoverage.description:
Which deployments of one unit a path counts, by the names the unit's kind
lists for them (for a KubernetesPublication, a deployment is an Argo CD
Application, or a Release on a direct target, and a group is an
ApplicationGroup).

exclude.description: Deployments knowingly accepted as falling short: they leave the unit's aggregate for this path, and each record lists them. A value consumed by an excluded deployment must still come from a publication it runs.

groups.description: Narrows the deployments that count toward a source promotion to those of these groups; it never narrows what moves, and a deployment in no group (such as a catalog) then does not count. Omitted, every group. A path that promotes only values judges each value for its own consumer, so validation refuses `groups` there.

require.description: Deployments that must meet the path's required attestations at whatever they run, without contributing values.

UnitName.description:
A unit's literal `metadata.name`, unique per environment across all
unit kinds. A Kubernetes DNS label.

description:
The explicit link between source selectors and target bindings, along
which `nyl promote` moves a proven source commit and selected values from
one environment's recorded state into another environment's desired state.

A path says which environment is the source and which the target, how
strong the evidence must be, and which source fields become named values
that `$promotion` bindings read. Source and target may differ in unit
names, input names, and document shape; the path states the mapping.

## When needed

To promote what one environment proved into another: a source commit, an
image digest, or any value a unit's input or a Release input should take
from another environment instead of rebuilding or retyping it.

## If omitted

Nothing is promoted between environments, and no environment may use a
`promotion` source or `$promotion` binding.
